'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Chris Westergard DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
